title: Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai

thread.title: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day • Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai - Episode 9 discussion

opinions.point: Many viewers considered the episode excellent and praised its emotional character writing.
The cast, especially Mimi and Sheena, received strong affection; several comments highlighted their evolving bond and emotional depth.
The new opening arrangement and visuals were repeatedly praised as powerful, beautiful, and emotionally effective.
Viewers appreciated the episode's warmer, more hopeful tone after several especially heavy episodes.
The animation and visual effects were described by multiple commenters as spectacular.
Some viewers liked the mature handling of the central moral dilemma, while others felt the decision was resolved too easily or followed a familiar formula.
Several commenters enjoyed the worldbuilding around magic, but others found terminology, character ages, and certain implications confusing or potentially inconsistent.
A minority criticized the institutional setting and questioned why the characters remain loyal to it.

title: Tai-Ari deshita.: Ojou-sama wa Kakutou Game nante Shinai

thread.title: Young Ladies Don’t Play Fighting Games • Tai-Ari deshita. Ojou-sama wa Kakutou Game Nante Shinai - Episode 9 discussion

opinions.point: The episode’s exaggerated tournament energy, tactical commentary, and fighting-game details were widely enjoyed.
Several commenters liked the depiction of players entering an intense flow state and the growing respect between competitors.
Arisa’s rude, unsportsmanlike attitude was repeatedly criticized, with many finding her more unpleasant than the nominal antagonists.
The extended match structure and frequent switching between games made some viewers eager for the continuation, while others felt it weakened the flow and dragged out the pacing.
A noticeable in-game visual continuity error involving health bars distracted some viewers.
Commenters appreciated that the protagonists were allowed to lose and develop rather than receiving effortless victories.
